title: Install on iPhone
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to download and install the iPhone app so that I can deposit checks from my iPhone.

title: Install on Android
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to download and install the Android app so that I can deposit checks from my Android phone.

title: Install on Windows Phone
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to download and install the Windows Phone app so that I can use the platform explicitly included in the case study.

title: Check RDC readiness
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to see account eligibility and setup guidance so that I know whether my existing remote capture account is ready.

title: Use portal credentials
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to sign in with my existing internet portal account so that I can use my established bank identity.

title: Use bank-approved alternative
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to use a bank-approved alternative identity check so that I can authenticate through another supported route.

title: End or lock my session
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to sign out and have an inactive session locked so that other people cannot view my banking information on the phone.

title: Enable biometric re-entry
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to opt into supported biometric re-entry after bank authentication so that I can return conveniently without weakening the bank session policy.

title: See my accounts
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to view accounts associated with my bank identity so that I can identify the right account before depositing.

title: View and refresh balances
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to see bank-provided balances and their refresh time so that I can distinguish current information from stale information.

title: Choose eligible destination
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to select an eligible deposit account so that my check goes to the account I intend.

title: Remember a preferred account
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to choose a preferred deposit account while confirming it each time so that repeat deposits require fewer selections.

title: Prepare camera and check
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to receive camera-permission and endorsement guidance so that I can prepare a usable check image.

title: Capture check front
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to capture a clear front image within the app so that the bank can read and validate the check face.

title: Capture check back
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to capture a clear back image within the app so that the bank receives both required sides.

title: Check quality; retake securely
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to preview and retake unreadable images and protect temporary copies so that I submit usable images without exposing them in my public photo gallery.

title: Use assisted camera capture
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to use edge detection and optional automatic capture so that I can take clearer images with less effort.

title: Enter check amount
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to enter the check amount explicitly so that the bank receives my intended deposit value.

title: Complete required check details
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to enter any additional check details required by bank policy so that my submission is complete before validation.

title: Match images to entered details
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to validate both images against my entered details and correct mismatches so that I do not submit an inconsistent amount or unreadable check.

title: Review suggested amount
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to review a suggested amount extracted from the image before accepting it so that I can reduce typing while retaining control of the declared amount.

title: Review deposit summary
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to review the account, amount, images and bank-provided terms so that I can correct errors before authorizing submission.

title: Confirm and submit e-check
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to authorize one secure submission of the validated e-check so that the bank can receive and process my deposit.

title: Resolve interrupted submission
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to check the outcome of an interrupted request before retrying so that I avoid accidentally submitting the same deposit twice.

title: Handle duplicate or fraud alerts
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to receive a clear bank validation result and next action so that a suspected duplicate or invalid check is not treated as a successful deposit.

title: Receive deposit acknowledgement
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to receive a deposit reference and bank-reported status so that I have evidence that the bank received my request.

title: Check outcome and balance
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to refresh the bank-reported deposit outcome and account balance so that I can tell pending processing from funds made available.

title: Get help when needed
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to open bank instructions or contact the existing support service so that I can recover from setup or deposit problems.

title: View deposit history
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to review prior deposit references and outcomes so that I can find a previous transaction without submitting it again.

title: Opt into status notifications
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to opt into notifications about deposit status changes so that I can learn of a bank decision without repeatedly opening the app.

title: See bank offers
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to view current bank offers in the app so that I can discover relevant banking opportunities.

title: Open offer details
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to open offer conditions and the bank-approved next action so that I can decide whether to respond without interrupting a deposit.

title: Dismiss offers and set preferences
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to dismiss an offer or manage optional promotion settings so that I can keep the app focused on my banking task.

title: Choose personalized offers
story: As a Blue Bank customer, I want to opt into personalized offers with clear preferences so that I receive more relevant offers if I choose.
